question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

MBTN, KCSP, IDRR, ?, EFPV
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First letter → (2) is from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (1) is from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth letter → (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5bc1b59431b6b91e0e9c33f9777cce688f09b373f187ce8b37eb9c274c6b3c1.png] 

Hence, "**GEQT**" is the correct answer.
